analysis: Examined base_text units for provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift, base lines 1756-3038. These cover ready-receipt monotonicity and the no-ready failure matrix, write-behind barrier tests, staging-reservation tests, root isolation and whole-root maintenance tests. They relate to T-041 mitigations (e)/(b): shared GlobalKVCacheBudget reservations, the free-space reserve, TTL/LRU and epoch handling. All shown lines are unchanged context; the file_changes range map is complete and shows the only change at head 3140-3240. That change adds test-only cases in SSDWholeRootMaintenanceTests. remembersHeaderVerdictsOnlyForUnchangedFiles expects a header corrupted after an earlier pass, with size and mtime preserved but ctime changed, to lose ownership, so no TTL or budget deletion follows. replacedLookalikeIsReadAgain expects a malformed lookalike replaced by a valid block to become owned. This implies production SSDWholeRootMaintainer now caches per-file header-ownership verdicts keyed on file metadata including ctime. That production source was not supplied. Integration should verify the cache key covers inode, dev, size, mtime and ctime. Same-UID operator replacement or rename could otherwise reuse a stale owned verdict and cause deletion of non-owned files under the kv3 root (a TB-003 local tamper/DoS concern), or a stale unowned verdict could block TTL expiry and widen T-041's at-rest retention. Test-only changes introduce no runtime attack surface, so there are no findings.
